closure_explanation: Targets: Theorems E.3 (Local SGD), E.5 (Cycle SGD) and E.6 (Async-Local SGD, user-approved corrected step size). Each statement needs the problem (PROB), Assumptions 1.1-1.3 (A1-A3), its method (ALGLOC/ALGCYC/ALGAL), the method's computation tree and main branch (TREELOC/TREECYC/TREEAL, built on TREE), Definition 2.1 (DBRANCH) and its setup with i.i.d. samples (S3/S5/S6). Each proof verifies Conditions 1-3 and applies Theorem 2.4 (T), so T and its accepted closure (ALG, TREE, DDIST, DREPR, C1-C3) are required; T is a convergence result and is reused from the library with its own public module. Because the three step sizes are smaller than Theorem 2.4's, the applications are made through the derived lemma TG (Theorem 2.4's estimates with gamma = min{1/(2 Rt L), eps/(4 sigma^2 L)}, Rt >= R + 1). E.5's and E.6's references to the proof of E.3 and 'previous proofs' are proof-technique context (source_reference), not result uses. Theorem E.4 (Ringmaster ASGD, mentioned as the M = 1 case of E.6), the other method theorems, Sections F-I and the experiments are context only and not required.
